_comment: Frozen baseline for the SHIPPED /aggregate ranking path. Recorded 2026-07-14 from evaluation.aggregator.run over 4 real SerpApi fixtures. must_beat_google asserts the product's core claim: our rating x review-volume blend orders offers BETTER than Google Shopping's own order (Google baseline: ndcg@3 0.824, mrr 0.875). If that stops being true, the aggregator has no reason to exist and CI should fail.
